_note: Curated from pylint-odoo v8.x for Odoo v16. v16: `UserError(_('msg', arg))` lazy format, `_('msg', arg)` translation lazy pattern, `web.Widget` deprecated. `_compute_display_name()`/`name_get()`: at v16 `name_get()` carries no deprecation marker at all (no `.. deprecated::`, no warning) - the deprecation signal starts v17 (`.. deprecated:: 17.0` + DeprecationWarning), removal is v18; see W8202 rule body below, which already states this correctly. `group_operator` still present at v16 (renamed `aggregator` v18 - verified: v17 fields.py has group_operator only, v18 fields.py has aggregator with a group_operator compat shim). `track_visibility` was renamed to `tracking` in v13, not v16 (verified: file-count of `track_visibility` usage collapses from v12 to v13 while `tracking=` usage climbs sharply, and v13's addons/mail/models/mail_thread.py itself reads `getattr(field, 'tracking', None) or getattr(field, 'track_visibility', None)` - a fallback that only makes sense if `tracking` is the new attribute as of v13) - see W8167 rule body below, which already states v13 correctly.

rules.message: `unlink()` override does not call `super()`.
`invalidate_cache()` removed — use `flush_recordset()` or `invalidate_recordset()`.
`web.Widget` class used — deprecated in v16; prefer OWL components.
`track_visibility` field attribute renamed to `tracking` in v13.
N+1 ORM query in loop: `browse()` or `search()` called inside a `for` loop over records.
Computed field missing `@api.depends` decorator — will never be recomputed automatically.
`search()` method override must return a recordset and call `super()`.
Many2one field missing `ondelete` parameter — defaults to 'set null' which may leave orphan references.
`digits=(16, 2)` tuple format deprecated — use a precision field name string.
`copy=True` set on a field with a unique SQL constraint — duplication will fail.
`default_get()` override does not call `super()` — default values from other modules will be lost.
`_sql_constraints` entry message is not wrapped in `_()` for translation.
`fields.Html` field without `sanitize=True` may allow XSS — verify sanitization is intentional.
`_order` attribute references a field that does not exist in the model.
Static assets declared via `qweb` key — use `assets` key with bundle names.
XPath `position='replace'` removes the target element entirely — verify this is intentional.
View inheritance without `inherit_id` — `<record model='ir.ui.view'>` missing `inherit_id` field.
OWL component class not registered via `registry` — component will not be accessible.
OWL component uses deprecated lifecycle hook `mounted` — use `onMounted` hook.
String formatting used in UserError/ValidationError — use lazy args or named placeholders instead of %-interpolation.
rules.fix_template:
raise UserError(_('Hello %(name)s') % {'name': name})  # acceptable
raise UserError(_('Hello %s', name))  # preferred (Odoo 16+ lazy format)

rules.message: `name_get()` override detected - deprecated from v17; use `_compute_display_name()` instead.
`_sql_constraints` entry uses invalid constraint type or malformed tuple.
Unexpected `var`. Use `let` or `const` instead.
Unexpected `console` statement in production JS.
Reference to undeclared variable.
Variable declared but never used.
OWL template references a component not imported.
Blind exception: do not catch `Exception` without re-raising or logging.
Line too long (exceeds max line length).
Import block is unsorted or has wrong grouping.
Module imported but unused.

Bare free-identifier arrow in t-on (e.g. t-on-click="() => onFoo()" where onFoo is not a component method, a prop, or a slot variable) resolves to nothing at render. Use t-on-click="onFoo" (auto-bound) or t-on-click="() => this.onFoo()" — both of those are valid.
A useService() result that drives the template should preserve reactivity: wrap it as useState(useService("...")) when the service is not already reactive. Confirm per service and target version.
Raw contenteditable bypasses the audited editor and its sanitisation. Delegate to the web_editor Wysiwyg, lazy-loaded in onWillStart with stable props.
t-set-slot="body" is invalid under <Dialog>: the body IS the default slot. Put body content in the default slot; only header and footer are named slots.
Possible SQL injection risk - string interpolation used in SQL query. Use parameterized queries instead.
